thread:
maria: heads up — I pushed a new onboard candidate v2.3-int4-hybrid to staging shadow. Can we agree a tight A/B + canary plan before we promote?

aj: saw the shadow run, quick notes: p50 latency +4ms, p95 +18ms, cost down ~22% on tokens. Need to watch long-doc MRR and hallucination.

sam: agree. propose phased ramp: 1% 30m -> 5% 2h -> 20% 6h, with automated rollback if quality regs hit.

lina: what are concrete rollback triggers? we should avoid noisy alerts.

maria: suggested thresholds from smoke eval:
- eval_win_rate_drop > 1.5 percentage points (relative) on primary slice AND
- hallucination_rate +0.35 ppt absolute increase
- or conv-level token-loss delta > 2.0 pts
if any of the above sustained for 30m we immediate-fallback.

aj: can we use an OR/AND composition to reduce false positives? e.g., require win_rate AND hallucination both hit to auto-fallback, but single-signal fires a paging alert.

sam: fine. let's codify: automatic fallback if (win_drop >= 1.5 AND hall_inc >= 0.35) OR (token_loss_delta >= 2.0). Single-signal -> oncall page and 5% hold.

lina: add significance checks: require at least 200 effective samples in the test slice and p-value < 0.05 for the win_rate drop window. Otherwise alert only.

maria: good call. Also add a silent backoff if latency p95 increases >50ms for 10m — that's a SLO trigger and should drop traffic to safe-tier.

sam: here's a compact config snippet for the rollout policy we can paste into the console (pseudo-YAML):

```
rollout:
  steps: [
    {pct: 1, duration: 30m},
    {pct: 5, duration: 2h},
    {pct: 20, duration: 6h}
  ]
  auto_fallback:
    conditions:
      - name: "win_and_hallucination"
        type: "composite"
        expr: "win_drop >= 1.5 AND hall_inc >= 0.35"
        window: 30m
        min_samples: 200
        action: "fallback"
      - name: "token_loss"
        type: "single"
        expr: "token_loss_delta >= 2.0"
        window: 30m
        action: "fallback"
      - name: "latency_slo"
        expr: "p95_increase >= 50"
        window: 10m
        action: "reduce_traffic:safe-tier"
```

aj: looks solid. add a quiet-burn shadow after step 2 for 1 hour to collect long-doc slices.

maria: will run a quiet-burn of 10% shadowed traffic tied to the long-doc slice after 2h. Also starting a targeted eval deck (1000 long-doc prompts + adversarial prompts) to measure hallucination variance.

lina: deploy-bot: kick off canary when we have the config and eval deck ready.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: model=v2.3-int4-hybrid, env=staging, mode=canary_shadow. RunID=deploy-20240222-17. Expected start 1739965600.

sam: once the first 30m step finishes, post the slice-level metrics here (win_rate, hall_rate, p95, sample_count). Keep messages concise.

maria: will do. If any metric crosses hard fallback we auto-route to v2.2-stable. :thumbsup:

aj: tiny follow-up — add an AB metric for rerank precision@1 on our rerank slice, want to ensure behavior parity on short prompts.

maria: added. thanks everyone. I'll post the smoke summary after first 30m.
